lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for sign_in reorder, home redesign, and finish hint changes because each kind of change has only one test so far.
Predictions were consistently too high across all tested changes.

candidates.title: Stage layout redesign for pet selection
candidates.change: Redesign the pet choice screen into a central stage layout featuring interactive preview cards and personality tags.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops significantly to 60.9% with a median time of 89s; a stage layout makes choosing faster and more visually compelling.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Desktop habitat selection screen
candidates.change: Add a new desktop habitat theme picker screen right before final intro screen.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% and takes a median 395s; customizing the pet's initial desktop environment increases user setup completion.

new_habitat_picker.headline: Select Your Desktop Habitat
new_habitat_picker.body: Pick the starting cozy corner for your pet to live on your screen.

guard.reason: Adds a valid habitat selection screen inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adding a new screen increases friction on an already low-converting finish step without support mail backing.

candidates.title: Post-intro sign-in reorder
candidates.change: Move sign-in to the very end of onboarding, after home intro visual setup.
candidates.why: Sign-in step has high mean time (567s) and 2 support tickets reported sign-in screen freezing before entry; pushing it post-intro lets users see the home view first.

guard.reason: home_intro must come after every existing screen, sign_in included

candidates.title: Interactive pet naming flow
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated naming screen with real-time text input and audio feedback right after adoption certificate.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is only 60.9%; giving users a dedicated naming ceremony deepens emotional connection and completion intent.

new_pet_naming.headline: Name Your New Pet
new_pet_naming.body: Give your desktop friend a unique name to finish adoption.

guard.reason: 'new_pet_naming.components[0]': inputs may only ask for the pet's name

candidates.title: Grid layout for path options
candidates.change: Display adoption path choices in a side-by-side grid of visual choice cards.
candidates.why: Choose path takes a mean 514s; a structured grid layout helps users compare pre-made vs custom pet options instantly.

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like to Create Your Pet?

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Background generation wait hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit status hint reassuring users that pet graphics are rendering in the background.
candidates.why: Home step waiting time is extremely high (median 201s, mean 2336s) and 3 support emails reported confusion over pets not showing up on desktop.

waiting.hint: We are preparing your pet's desktop animation files in the background. It will pop up automatically shortly!

guard.reason: Adds informative status hint and real time estimate to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: High wait time in home step backed by 3 support emails; simple config hint reduces drop-off.

candidates.title: One-click sign in copy tweak
candidates.change: Simplify sign-in headline and body copy to highlight instant one-click authentication.
candidates.why: 8 support emails mentioned lost or reset pets after signing in again; clearer single-account sign-in copy prevents duplicate account creation.

sign_in.headline: Quick One-Click Sign In
sign_in.body: Use your primary account to save your companion so your pet is always preserved when re-logging in.

guard.reason: Valid copy update for the sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Strong support mail evidence (8 emails) and low cost text change.

candidates.title: First-day treat starter gift incentive
candidates.change: Display a treat pack bonus reward badge on the final welcome screen.
candidates.why: Finish step drop-off is 35.2%; providing an immediate in-app reward incentive encourages users to click finish and enter desktop mode.

components.text: Bonus Unlocked: First-Day Treat Pack Added to Inventory!

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions a bonus gift, which violates rule 3.

candidates.title: Photo upload quality checker widget
candidates.change: Add a photo clarity checker preview component with upload tips on the photo upload screen.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or weird visual glitches caused by bad photo uploads.

upload_photos.hint: For best custom pet results, upload a well-lit photo with a single clear subject.

guard.reason: Adds a helpful image quality checker component to the photo upload screen.

candidates.score_note: Targeting adoption step which has highest drop (39.1% loss) supported by 3 mail reports, but requires code release.

candidates.title: Desktop ready tray notification
candidates.change: Enable ready notifications on the waiting screen so users get alerted when generation finishes.
candidates.why: Home wait time has a huge mean of 2336s, indicating users minimize the app while waiting and forget about it.

components.text: Feel free to minimize this window. We'll send a system notification when your pet is ready!

guard.reason: Adds a ready notification feature to the waiting screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Extremely high mean time (2336s) indicates users forget background rendering; tray notifications bring users back.

lessons_next: Predictions were consistently too high across all tested changes.
Evidence is still thin across all kinds of changes because each kind has only one test so far.
Reordering sign-in was the only change with a winning test (sign_in, reorder), though evidence remains thin.
Redesigning the home screen (home, redesign) made onboarding worse, and adding a new finish screen (finish, new_screen) triggered a guardrail rollback.
No clear effect was seen for hint changes (finish, hint and home, hint), copy tweaks (sign_in, copy), or adoption wait info widgets (adoption, wait_info).
